notes.title: First Major Update! OST on Sale NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear Researchers in HERE,

Thank you for your patience. 

After more than a month of polishing, we’re excited to bring you this major update. This update includes major enhancements to the main game, along with the release of the original soundtrack, which is available as a separate purchase. Here’s what’s new:

Three New Simulation Levels Added to Training Mode:

Sync Chip02、Sync Chip03、Hacking Pratice03 will unlock once the Sync Chip skill is acquired.

All-New First-Person Mode for Aiming:

Now players can press R1/RB while aiming to switch to a first-person view.

More MORE appearances:

After meeting Rika, MORE will appear during loading screens (can be 100% triggered by restarting the checkpoint); additional appearances occur in New Game+.

Mini-Map Added in New Game+:

Toggle on/off via Options -> HUD -> Minimap.

Skill Try-on Now Available in Mod.EXE Interface:

Try out certain skills before unlocking them or familiarize yourself with new mechanisms after unlocking them!

In the modexe interface, hold Triangle/Y on the following skill icons to enter test mode: 1) Virus container 2) Vulnerability hacker 3) Proxy 4) Sync Chip. 

This concludes the update. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please let us know! We'll continue to improving the game based on them.

Thanks!

notes.title: Stealth hacking game Evotinction explores the dark side of AI
notes.notes:
Evotinction is a game that instantly calls to mind a whole slew of other titles. Dead Space, System Shock, or even Watch Dogs. Evotinction is a stealth hacking title about stopping an AI from killing all of humanity - as it is so often wont to do - and it's out now on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: EVOTINCTION is now officially Released!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your patience! We're thrilled to announce that EVOTINCTION is now officially available on Steam. Developed with Unreal Engine 4, the game features full voice acting and supports advanced PC features like DLSS and ray tracing for an enhanced experience.

While it’s possible to rush through levels with the resources at hand, the game emphasizes and encourages stealthy gameplay. With a bit of strategic thinking and careful study of the environment, Dr. Thomas Liu can navigate the seemingly impenetrable digital fortress without having to confront the patrolling rogue AI robots. Our goal is to offer a unique and immersive experience through this approach.

Here are a few key points we’d like to highlight:

[list]
[*] The Day-One Limited Edition includes a handy resource pack to help Dr. Liu infiltrate the facility with ease, along with unique cosmetic items like the exclusive Panda Suit camouflage. The original soundtrack (OST) will also be arriving later, so stay tuned!
[*] The PC version comes with several new features, so we encourage you to explore and experiment with them as you progress. If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out—we welcome you to join our Discord community to share your feedback, ask questions, or just chat about the game.
[*] To achieve 100% completion, multiple playthroughs (2+) will be necessary. Don’t worry if you miss items like photos or recordings during your first run—your progress will carry over into New Game+.
[*] The game features full English voice acting, led by Donna Burke, known for her work in the Metal Gear Solid series. We hope you enjoy the incredible performances!
[*] Steam Deck is currently supported, though not yet fully optimized. We will continue to improve compatibility through future updates.
[*] Lastly, we are committed to patching and optimizing the game over time. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to leave a message on our Discord https://discord.gg/8CexMWB92d or the Steam Discussion forum. We’re actively listening to the community and working to make the game even better based on your input.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the experience and wish you success as you infiltrate the AI-controlled digital fortress to save humanity!

Best regards,
Spikewave Games & Astrolabe Games

notes.title: Available Sep-13 With DLSS 3, Ray Tracing & Reflex
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

In [i]Spikewave Games[/i] and [i]Astrolabe Games’[/i] EVOTINCTION you’re Dr. Liu, the only one who can stop rogue AIs in a futuristic research facility.

Use a variety of hacking skills to overcome robotic threats and uncover the secrets that hold the key to humanity's survival or its potential extinction. With no combat skills, Dr. Liu must rely on his wits, stealth, and tech savviness to hack, disrupt and overcome enemy AIs and the robots they control.

[previewyoutube=Q8DyTUd8JYY;full][/previewyoutube]

When EVOTINCTION launches September 13th, the PC edition will be enhanced by ray-traced reflections, and it’ll also include day-one support for DLSS 3 and Reflex, accelerating performance and making gameplay more responsive.

On GeForce RTX 40 Series GPUs, DLSS Super Resolution and Frame Generation multiply frame rates by 3.9X on average at 4K, with all settings maxed out, and ray tracing enabled, giving everyone with a GeForce RTX 4070 and faster GPU the definitive experience:

At 2560x1440 and 1920x1080, frame rates are accelerated by up to 2.6X on average, enabling every GeForce RTX 40 Series GPU owner to play at over 60 FPS with settings completely maxed:

notes.title: Coming September 13 to PC and PS5
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that the long-awaited sci-fi stealth game 'Evotinction' will officially launch on [b]September 13, 2024[/b], for both Steam and PlayStation 5!

Developed by Spikewave Games under the prestigious China Hero Project by Sony Interactive Entertainment, 'Evotinction' has been in development for seven years. This hard work has culminated in a game that offers over ten hours of fully-voiced story content, innovative level designs, and sophisticated hacking mechanics, delivering a unique and immersive stealth experience.

Visit our Store page to wishlist 'Evotinction' and stay up-to-date with the latest news and events as we approach the launch date.

Thank you for your continued support. We can't wait for you to experience 'Evotinction'!

[b]Intro[/b]
Near future, in a remote research facility named HERE, the AI system controlling the facility got infected by a virus called RED, and subsequently went rogue, starting to attack humans. Dr. Liu decides to infiltrate this lost facility on his own to face the AI, uncover the truth, and save humanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/fb5374362b1156f6e08372deee053af3b6bb2ba6.png[/img]

[b]Near Future Dystopian Sci-Fi[/b]

Near Future.

A virus of unknown origin breached the network of an isolated, self-sustained research facility and community named HERE.
Inevitably, the core unit of the highly-advanced AI system that runs the facility got infected.
As a result, those harmless service robots went out of control and started to attack humans.
Dr. Liu, Head of R&D at HERE and one of the architects of the system, decided to go back into this lost facility to search for possible survivors while attempting to identify and fix the underlying issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/2ed62c4f53469864f94c1b2a8d69890d40733f2e.png[/img]

[b]Futuristic Tactical Infiltrate Simulation[/b]

A one-man infiltration into an AI-controlled rampart.
Utilize the kaleidoscopic hacking skills the doctor masters to cope with adversaries.
Disable the security system remotely, rewrite IFF IDs, or manipulate rogue AI's behaviour...
Do what you can to avoid any unnecessary encounters.
Make your way in stealthily and neutralize all threats one by one.
Go deep into the heart of the facility to face the core crisis!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/d866b4aeaebdc8f85a2b951c7ce5b68fb4e10751.png[/img]

[b]Core Crisis, Machine Awakening[/b]

"Genie" - those everyday service robots will be your most common opponents.
Each of those service robots has its routine patrol, and the AI system behind their behaviours also coordinates the efforts of those robots to maximize their efficiency.
In addition, the doctor will encounter certain killer robots specially-engineered to neutralize any threats to the core system as he gets deeper into the facility.
Could the infected AI be to blame for everything?
Or perhaps there are additional unidentified reasons lurking somewhere?
All will be eventually revealed along with the doctor's investigation...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/185ad1b03a6a1aa6d3e5b2cfddf6a6ef7ada4295.png[/img]

[b]Tech-Augmented Hack-and Stealth[/b]

Not your traditional protagonist, Dr. Liu, an ordinary researcher who had absolutely zero combat training, will have to infiltrate the facility on his own. 
Not a specialist in melee combat, nor a slick gunslinger, the doctor is just an average joe when it comes to "combat". 
However, as a tech-savvy researcher, he is able to hack, disrupt, and manipulate all these rogue AIs to guide himself through this dangerous automated facility. 
Long-Range Signal Disrupting, Radio & Electromagnetic Jamming, Hologram Illusion, Malware Implant, System Takeover, IFF Spoofing…
Make use of the doctor's full arsenal of gadgets to hack a way inside and out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/51627627cfc728942af09058e11ae41175a50b99.png[/img]

Dev & Publishing Team
June 19, 2024
